CORRECTED. בְּתוֹךְ is rendered by the single English word *in*, so rule 30 fuses preposition and construct noun as it does בְּיַד → *by*, headed on the lexeme-bearing תָּוֶךְ; the verbless clause's supplied copula *were* joins the unit under rules 49 and 30. The accepted reading gave *in* to בְּ alone and marked תָּוֶךְ `unrepresented`, against rule 30's express preference for one fused unit over a rendered morpheme beside an unrepresented one.
Suffix → *it* (rule 18).
The oath formula חַי־אָנִי is written *As I live*; the adjective takes *As … live*, headed on *live* (rule 55).
Explicit pronoun takes only its own *I*.
נְאֻם → *saith*.
Supplied *the* belongs to the nominal expression it determines (rule 15).
The suffix of אֲדֹנָי is not separately rendered (rule 22).
Divine name → *Jehovah*.
Verb with subject pronoun and modal; head on the lexical predicate (rules 17, 24).
The first oath אִם takes the opening correlative *neither* (rule 14).
Noun → *son*.
The second אִם takes the closing correlative *nor*: no waw stands in this phrase to claim it (rule 14).
Noun → *daughter*.
Independent pronoun → *they*.
Verb with its modal; head on the lexical predicate. Discontinuous around the supplied *but* (rule 25).
The restrictive *but* stands in a clause with no conjunction morpheme; no morpheme licenses it (rules 14, 30).
The emphatic possessive *their own* belongs whole to the suffix (rule 18).
Noun → *souls*.
Suffix → *their*.
Noun → *righteousness*.

review_notes: Corrected: בְּתוֹכָהּ → *were in it* now fuses בְּ+תוֹךְ to *were in* under rule 30 (headed on תָּוֶךְ), with the copula joining that unit under rule 49, replacing the accepted split that left תָּוֶךְ `unrepresented`.
Variant WLC.EZK.14.20.v003 is underdetermined and the projection carries the r00-base reading of דָּנִיֵּאל (s003), which the ASV's *Daniel* permits; no rule 53 case arises.
Unlike EZK.14.16, no waw stands between the two אִם clauses here, so the second אִם itself carries the closing *nor*.
The restrictive *but* of *should but deliver* is `added`: that clause writes no conjunction.
